# Analía Camarda

> Analía Camarda is a Deaf Digital Entrepreneur, author, and educator. She helps the Deaf and Hard of Hearing community build financial independence through digital business, passive income strategies, and online education.

## About

Analía Camarda is the founder of Deaf Digital Pro, an online platform and academy designed specifically for Deaf and Hard of Hearing professionals who want to build digital businesses, generate passive income, and overcome communication barriers in the professional world. She is the author of 4 e-books available in English and Spanish, and runs a free online community on Skool.

- Website: https://www.analiacamarda.com
- Email: hola@analiacamarda.com
- WhatsApp: +1 239 331 6702
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/deafdigitalpro/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/analia-camarda-2b4152102/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@academydigital1
- Academy (Skool): https://www.skool.com/deafdigitalpro

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need previous experience to read the e-books?**
No. All guides are designed for complete beginners with no prior business or digital marketing experience.

**How do I receive the e-book after purchase?**
After completing your purchase via Stripe or PayPal, you will receive an email at the address you provided with a secure download link to access your PDF.

**Are the e-books available in both English and Spanish?**
Yes. Each title is available in both languages. The English and Spanish versions are separate books with equivalent content adapted for each audience.

**How can I join the free academy?**
Visit https://www.skool.com/deafdigitalpro and join for free. No credit card required.

**Can I contact Analía directly?**
Yes. Via email at hola@analiacamarda.com or WhatsApp at +1 239 331 6702.
